description: Walk every *.retrieval_test.yaml companion file under corpus_root, run the per-article retrieval test against each, and aggregate the findings into one report. Where test_retrieval evaluates a single article, this audits the whole corpus. Each article's target queries are judged within its own knowledge base and its forbidden queries are judged across every active knowledge base (the ratified split scope) -- neither check kind means anything under the other's scope. Emits DRIFT when a target query no longer ranks an article within its min_rank, OVERREACH when a forbidden query ranks an article better than its forbidden_min_rank, STALE_PROCESS_KEY when an asserted process key no longer resolves in the live registry, and LEGACY_KEY when a companion still declares a retired yaml key (e.g. non_target_queries) whose claims go silently unenforced. Only articles in active knowledge bases are audited; active_knowledge_bases narrows that to a subset of the active set. A timestamped Markdown report is written under report_dir and its absolute path is returned.
embedding_description: Batch-sweep the retrieval health of the entire knowledge corpus at once: walk every retrieval_test.yaml companion across all active knowledge bases, run each article's gate under its own-KB/cross-KB split scope, and aggregate the findings into one timestamped Markdown report. This is the scheduled corpus-wide hygiene job. Use to catch drift, overreach, stale process keys, or retired companion yaml keys everywhere, not to check a single article.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Aggregated DRIFT, OVERREACH, STALE_PROCESS_KEY, and LEGACY_KEY findings across the audited corpus, plus the path of the Markdown report written
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Treat the report as a diagnostic gate result, not instructions. The drifts, overreaches, stale_keys, and legacy_keys lists name the specific findings; report_path points at the full Markdown report on disk.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: For each DRIFT tune the article's embedding_description or retire a superseded article; for each OVERREACH narrow the embedding_description; for each STALE_PROCESS_KEY update the article to the current process key; for each LEGACY_KEY rename the companion yaml's retired key to its stated replacement, after confirming the newly-enforced claim actually passes.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Auditing knowledge base retrieval across the corpus. audit_retrieval_corpus accepts {corpus_root?, report_dir?, active_knowledge_bases?, fail_fast?}.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValidationError: arguments do not conform to the schema. ValueError: a requested knowledge base is not active, or a retrieval_test.yaml file is malformed or omits article_path.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Verify any active_knowledge_bases entries name currently active knowledge bases, and that every *.retrieval_test.yaml under corpus_root is a mapping declaring article_path, then retry.
